title: Skill Registry Entry
description: 每个 .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md 对应的元数据条目

name.description: Skill 唯一标识，与 .agents/skills/ 目录名一致

description.description: 一句话说明 skill 用途

primary_script.description: Skill 包内被首先调用的脚本路径，如 'scripts/validate.py'

expected_tool_calls.description: 执行此 skill 时必须出现的 tool call（silent-bypass 检测）

validation_commands.description: 验证 skill 输出是否正确的命令列表

layer_constraints.description: 此 skill 允许读写的架构层

known_failure_modes.description: 已知的失败模式和缓解策略

silent_bypass_risks.description: 此 skill 可能被 silent-bypass 的场景

invocation_mode.description: Who may start this skill: user (top-level execution request), model (another skill or agent), or both

skill_kind.description: Composition role: orchestrator coordinates other skills; discipline is reusable execution behavior; domain owns specialized technical knowledge; gate returns a formal readiness/correctness verdict

completion_criteria.description: Externally observable conditions signaling skill completion

composes.description: Names of skills this orchestrator invokes; only orchestrators may compose
